errors.text_span: sind die Balken in Gruppen zu je einem Balken pro MoE-Layer-Index gruppiert
errors.evidence: The charts are stacked bar charts, but the description incorrectly uses the term 'gruppiert' (grouped). A grouped bar chart would have multiple bars side-by-side for each index, which is not the case here.

errors.text_span: wie in der Legende oben rechts angegeben
errors.evidence: The legend in both charts is located at the top center of the plot area, not at the top right ('oben rechts').

errors.text_span: während Expert 3 (grün) in den mittleren und späten Schichten (z. B. Index 15, 19, 23) einen dominierenden Anteil aufweist
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that Expert 3 (green) has a dominant share at index 19 in the 'Text' chart. In the 'Text' chart, at index 19, Expert 2 (orange) is the dominant expert with a share of approximately 85%, while Expert 3 has no share.
